$Comment: A nightly contract on Old Jack's board. Its Parent, Hallows_Eve_Contract_Base, posts it in the night slots and pays it through Rewards.Auto the moment the work is done, because the board goes away with the event and a Claim would wait a year for it. The Requires block keeps it out of every draw while the event is off. It writes its own Rewards.Auto, the base's list with MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row added (Defense XP for the fight), because a child's list replaces the base's whole. A server without that mod skips the row.
